result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads and traffic calming measures. The surrounding environment is industrial with minimal greenery or pedestrian-scale amenities, creating a functional but exposed walking environment.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate safe crossing times.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design and lack of physical buffers or narrowing may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add street trees or a furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

result.summary: The image depicts an industrial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk across the side street. The environment is characterized by wide roadways and a lack of traffic calming or signalization, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds. The pavement surface is visibly degraded with significant cracking and patching throughout the intersection.

hazards.name: Poor pavement quality
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven patching in the roadway and intersection area can create tripping hazards and affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: The intersection lacks visible stop signs or signals for the primary roadway, potentially leading to high-speed conflicts with pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to increase driver awareness.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a wide industrial corridor featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals, but it lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads. The area is dominated by heavy truck traffic and lacks any physical buffers or greenery, creating a utilitarian and somewhat hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Heavy Truck Traffic
hazards.description: The presence of multiple large semi-trucks in an industrial zone increases the risk of severe accidents due to vehicle size and blind spots.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an industrial setting with a wide roadway and faded crosswalk markings. While a sidewalk exists on one side, the lack of pedestrian signals and a missing sidewalk on the opposite side create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk on the right side of the road, forcing pedestrians into the dirt or roadway.
